root_cause.finding: SignalPrecedence is currently derived only from signal_out ports. Connector/interface terminals are represented as passive ports, so an external interface feeding signal_in consumers contributes no compiler-enforced precedence obligation when that net has no internal signal_out producer.
root_cause.required_generic_fix: For a net with signal_in consumers and no internal signal_out producer, derive source precedence from the terminal-backed external interface port(s) on that net to each signal_in consumer. Do not infer source precedence on nets that already have an internal signal_out producer. Preserve incomparable sibling semantics: create source-to-child obligations only, never child-to-child ordering.

qualification_impact: Behavior-affecting semantic/placement change. After repair, rerun exact-head fast validation, five-run I1-I6 locked-KiCad interaction qualification, and fresh 56-positive x5 final qualification before completion reconciliation.
